data.one_liner: Generate request routers for the shelf web-framework using source annotations.
data.what_it_does: It provides a builder compatible with package:build that automatically generates request routers for the Shelf web framework based on annotations in code. It allows developers to define routes cleanly inside service classes rather than manually wiring handlers together.
use_when: Building web applications or servers using the shelf framework
You prefer annotation-driven route generation over manual configuration
avoid_when: Not using the shelf web framework
You prefer manual router configuration without build_runner steps
strengths: Keeps routing logic organized inside respective service classes
Integrates seamlessly with build_runner and source_gen
weaknesses: Requires running a build step via build_runner
Adds code generation boilerplate to the project
data.setup_notes: Add shelf_router_generator and build_runner to dev_dependencies, then run build_runner to generate routing code.
